entries.purpose: Run every tracked bash test suite the way CI's Bash tests job does
entries.output: PASS or FAIL per suite, the failures' logs, the slowest suites and a summary; exit 1 when a suite failed
entries.stop: ends when every suite ran; each suite gets its own temp HOME and AW_STATE_DIR, removed after; --list prints the suites without running them

entries.purpose: Check the docs and skills Markdown for slop, hedges, vague verbs and long sentences with Vale
entries.output: file:line:col: error|warning Rule: message per hit; exit 1 on an error
entries.stop: exits when done; --base REF keeps only hits on lines added since REF

entries.purpose: Check that .env.example lists every environment variable the code reads
entries.output: one line per variable that is missing or stale; exit 1 on drift

entries.purpose: Check that skills name the toolkit as ${AW_TOOLKIT:-...} and the output dir as $AW_DIR
entries.output: file:line per hit; exit 1 on drift

entries.purpose: Check that every skill that writes git state reads AW_GIT_MODE and refuses under readonly
entries.output: file:line per hit; exit 1 on drift

entries.purpose: Check that every skill that adds a git worktree takes its path from skills/_shared/worktree-path.sh
entries.output: file:line per hit; exit 1 on drift, 2 usage

entries.purpose: Check that the rule links and the Rules Index match .agents/rules/
entries.output: what is out of date; exit 1 when a link or the index is stale
entries.stop: exits when done; without --check it rewrites the links and the index

entries.purpose: Check deps.yaml against the code: schema, tiers, cycles and undeclared edges
entries.output: one line per finding; exit 1 on drift; --mermaid also prints the graph

entries.purpose: Check that every C# rule in the spec has a rule record and every active check exists
entries.output: one line per finding; --json for objects; exit 1 on a finding
